title: alchemilla hybrida var. plicata
intro: Alchemilla hybrida var. plicata, commonly known as the Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a perennial plant species within the Rosaceae family, characterized by its unique foliage and white or pink flowers. The Alpine Lady's Mantle is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving wound healing, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing and calming the skin, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, tannins, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
